title: Data on Appeal Rates for All HDB Schemes
what_it_is: Data on Appeal Rates for All HDB Schemes

sections.label: HDB appeals and housing policies
sections.summary: Appeals average around 177,000 per year across housing issues, assessed on individual merits, while MND and HDB review policies regularly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Appeals comprise a subset of these, averaging around 177,000 appeals per year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These appeals spanned a wide range of issues, such as eligibility for purchase of HDB flats, HDB housing loans and housing grants, housing maintenance issues, public rental housing and parking offences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB takes into consideration the unique circumstances of each case when assessing appeals, and the outcome of each appeal will depend on their individual merits.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Ministry of National Development (MND) and HDB regularly review our housing policies and schemes to ensure that we cater to the evolving needs and aspirations of Singaporean households, and to meet national objectives.

sections.label: Newer schemes and appeal load
sections.summary: Parking offences make up about 40% of appeals, housing-related appeals the bulk of the remainder, and schemes are reviewed regularly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: For the newer schemes, whether it is possible to design these with the aim to reduce the likelihood of appeals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: I believe the Member's interests will be in housing-related appeals, so I should add that in the numbers that I have shared with him just now, it includes appeals for parking related offences, which constitute approximately about 40% of the appeal load.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Housing-related appeals would be the bulk of the remainder.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: And we will be reviewing our schemes quite regularly, to make sure that they meet the evolving needs of Singaporeans.

sections.label: Deserving cases and appeals process
sections.summary: Appeals are answered for deserving cases, and schemes will continue to be reviewed and streamlined wherever possible.

sentences.text: For deserving cases, we will look at these appeals and provide an answer accordingly.

So, I think outside of these cases where either, there is already a framework and the members of the public know it but they want to appeal nonetheless; or cases where because of changing circumstances, we do need the appeals process in order to ensure that the outcome is fair for the member of the public; we will, nonetheless, continue to review and streamline our schemes wherever possible.
